# 0.4.19

## 本次更新

- 修复 Cookie 持久化丢失：持久化快照现在保留每个 Cookie 的完整元数据（域名、路径、过期时间、Secure/HttpOnly），不再折叠成 name→value 表。同名的 `.deviantart.com` 与 `.www.deviantart.com` Cookie 不再互相覆盖，更新/重启后按原元数据恢复，避免每次都要重新登录；旧的快照格式会自动迁移。
- 修复登录验证竞态：服务端验证现在合并并发调用、共享同一次在途校验，并用代际计数丢弃迟到的匿名/失败结果，旧校验不再覆盖更新一次的登录成功状态。
- 修复匿名页误登出：登录页中途的匿名页面（登录页加载、人机验证、Cookie 存储暂未就绪）不再把已确认登录的会话降级为未登录；只有显式登出才清除会话。
- 修复往下加载卡住时没有提示：分页失败且列表已有内容时，现在会显示加载转圈或“重试”按钮；点“重试”会立即重新发起分页，不再被退避窗口静默吞掉。

- Fixes cookie persistence loss: the persisted snapshot now keeps each cookie's full metadata (domain, path, expiry, Secure/HttpOnly) instead of collapsing to a name→value map, so same-name `.deviantart.com` vs `.www.deviantart.com` cookies no longer overwrite each other and are restored with their original metadata after an update/restart. Legacy snapshots migrate automatically.
- Fixes the login verification race: concurrent server checks now share one in-flight verification, and a generation counter discards stale anonymous/failure results so an old check cannot override a newer successful login.
- Fixes spurious logout from anonymous pages: a transient anonymous page during login (login-page load, bot challenge, cookie store not ready) no longer downgrades a confirmed signed-in session; only explicit logout clears it.
- Fixes silent pagination stalls: when a next page fails and the list already has content, the feed now shows a spinner or a visible "Retry" button; tapping Retry restarts pagination immediately instead of being silently swallowed by the backoff window.
